mutants.name: mount-owner-after-hold
mutants.old:
let v = controller.hostView()
        v.owner = controller
        controller.view = v
        slot.hold(v)
        return v
mutants.new:
let v = controller.hostView()
        slot.hold(v)
        v.owner = controller
        controller.view = v
        return v
